openrouter._comment: Reference only: OpenRouter costs are read from its generation endpoint. Rows quote each maker's own endpoint (not the cheapest reseller), so the share of wrong numbers stays small. Peak and long-context rates carry their window in the description. Source: GET /api/v1/models/<id>/endpoints (2026-11-12); the rows below are the top of its October 2026 token-volume ranking plus the frontier names.

opencode._comment: OpenCode Go subscription (opencode.ai/inference/go/openai/v1). The two DeepSeek rows carry OFF-PEAK Go token rates and config/peak_rates.py doubles them in the peak windows, because Go lists those models with a peak. Every other Go model has no peak window, so its rate here is final. Go bills a flat monthly subscription, so these dollars track allowance consumption, not an invoice. Source: opencode.ai/docs/console/go (2026-11-12)
